qa_pairs.question: What specific usage statistics does the "IOPS disque" graph display for cloud virtual machines in the Metrix portal?
qa_pairs.answer: The "IOPS disque" graph, part of the cloud statistics in the Metrix portal, displays the disk input/output operations per second (IOPS) for individual cloud virtual machines.

qa_pairs.question: What timeframes are available for users to view the disk IOPS statistics of their cloud virtual machines in the Metrix portal?
qa_pairs.answer: Users can view the disk IOPS statistics for their cloud virtual machines in the Metrix portal for various timeframes, including the last month, the last week, the last day, or the last hour.
